entities.name: Pregnancy vaccine timing
observations: CDC pregnancy guidance: Tdap is recommended in each pregnancy, preferably at 27–36 gestational weeks; varicella is contraindicated during pregnancy; HPV vaccination should be deferred until after pregnancy.
CDC guidance indicates hepatitis B vaccination for pregnant patients if not already vaccinated.

entities.name: Influenza vaccine, inactivated
observations: Injectable inactivated influenza vaccine is appropriate during pregnancy; live-attenuated intranasal influenza vaccine is not recommended during pregnancy.
